name: email-guard
description: Keeps your own email address out of Claude's context and blocks tool calls that would send it off the machine.

extraEmails.title: Extra addresses
extraEmails.description: More addresses to protect, separated by commas. The Claude login and git config addresses are found on their own.

keepInContext.title: Keep the account email in Claude's context
keepInContext.description: Off: the userEmail block is dropped, so Claude never sees the address. Tool calls are guarded either way.
